headline: Sigma secures Rs 174 crore artillery ammunition order
hook: New export win for Hyderabad-based Sigma
summary: Hyderabad-based Sigma has received an order worth Rs 174 crore from a North American customer. The contract involves the supply of artillery ammunition subsystems. Execution of the order is scheduled to be completed by the second quarter of 2027.
why_it_matters: Boosts export revenue visibility for the company through 2027.
